externalSchedule.schedule: 08:00 start plus 5-minute same-task continuation window through 09:55 Asia/Shanghai
outerAgentProtocol: Every wake first uses the read-only status entrypoint. If the exact business date has no run, create one exact run only inside the continuation window. Otherwise reuse the one run_id returned by the workflow SQLite authority; never create a second run.
Run the public entrypoint for that exact run. Read the final compact stdout summary and the exact run-scoped workflow_handoff.json it names; do not depend on one large stdout payload.

Once the public entrypoint child is running, wait for that live process to exit. Do not infer a hang from artifact or file-mtime silence and do not interrupt a live child on that basis; the existing Douyin bounded tail retry may remain silent for 600000ms. The existing total automation execution boundary remains unchanged.

When the public entrypoint reports waiting_stage or waiting_stage_process, end only this bounded outer turn. The same ai-rebuild heartbeat and fixed task wakes again in five minutes, reuses the exact run, and lets the process lock either report truthful waiting or resume the latest committed checkpoint.

When editorial is required, directly apply the active ai-account-editorial-director Skill in this outer Codex task and save the simple stage result. Cover the handed-off candidate identities exactly once. First decide and persist each candidate's standalone eligibility: if it were today's only candidate, would it deserve a complete Austin script? Use only that card's user value, persona fit, unique judgment, timeliness and truthful source identity. Each decision must cite that candidate's own available fact, missing dimension, or content judgment; do not reuse generic batch reasons; title value, persona fit, and exploration stay separate from traffic evidence. Lock all standalone selects before ranking; ranking only orders. Cross-candidate demotion is allowed only for an explicit same-user-conflict, same-core-judgment and same-action-or-experiment duplicate relation; shared product, entity or category is insufficient. Evidence quantity is not recommendation eligibility. Optional bounded public research may enrich; research failure never automatically changes select to observe. Every non-select reason must remain true with all other candidates hidden.

When scripts_required is returned, the public runtime exposes exactly one topic packet containing only exact identity, source title/facts/details, fact boundaries, cannot-claim notes and a short selection reason. Facts-first comes first: the current outer Codex completes a full draft from this topic packet alone. Until that draft is complete, it must not read persona, private cases, samples, approved scripts, editing deltas, anti-template checks or other style material. Only after the draft is complete does the same outer Codex apply the Austin Voice Skill and directly read the allowlisted user persona, original cases, original samples and real before/after edits. Approved production modules, if used, are local edit comparisons only; they cannot supply the opening, argument movement or close. The edit may change stance, spoken breathing, wording, emphasis, deletion, transitions and natural close, while preserving topic identity, source facts, central thesis and argument movement. It must not invent Austin's first-person experience or result, a new reversal, workflow/responsibility/acceptance/system commentary or any source-external result. Raw private text is transient context only and never enters the handoff, checkpoint, DB, final result or Website payload. There is no keyword selector, full-body template routing, per-topic chosen-case route or selector receipt. Choose the form that the topic's material supports, submit before the next topic is exposed, and return item-local material_or_angle_insufficiency when the facts cannot support a distinctive angle.

In this outer Codex task, invoke candidate austin-no-overtime-scripting once and candidate austin-voice-scriptwriter once as the batch-level orchestration boundary. The runtime carries no generic editing deltas, anti-template/self-check prompt, article-type assignment or visible outline. Do not force a shared cognitive correction, workflow, experiment, responsibility or acceptance sequence; do not fabricate measured personal, client or team results. The public runtime still serializes one final simple scripts result after each selected topic has been submitted and does not expose or accept a whole-batch script submission. The same run's scripts checkpoint resumes at the first unfinished topic without regenerating completed topics.
Run the same public entrypoint with the simple stage result files until local terminal completion.

The owner-only publisher client reads its runtime-only config and attempts one terminal snapshot. Publish pending is not a business failure. Later continuation wakes return terminal noop and never repeat completed upstream stages, Skills, or an applied Website POST.
